answer: The vertex lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the hollow is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Reaching the reef of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, revoked by a single upheld challenge, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
